notes.title: Pre-Alpha Update 0.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the enemies to ignore replay ghosts.
[*]Implemented an additional mechanic to the safezone which will mostly affect the entry into a map from the start area.  This mechanic prevents attacks until the player has both exited the safe zone and has made contact with ground. This will reduce the mass of players being hit by blasts at the beginning of the race.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Update 0.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that carried references from other maps. This was preventing the replay from opening.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a coin ball to form above the start area's portal during a race recording.  These coins are created as the instant reward for hitting boxes or enemies but they were not despawning properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Update 0.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Mars and Skatepark maps are playable again.
[*]Enemies, most observed with the zombies, were causing the recording to break when a single one was hit multiple times in a particular order. Hitting the enemies in any order will no longer break the recording.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Update 0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]fixed some issues that may be corrupting replay files
[*]fixed an issue of coin clusters not being received
[*]general error prevention safeties
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Massively improved framerate with a large quantity of ghosts playing in a replay
[*]Optimizations for the blast ability
[*]Lod fixes for some skins
[*]Error preventing fixes around UI
[*]Various other safety/stability fixes
[/list]
